recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; any future package-count regression should be handled with a new issue citing current package URLs and counts.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive technical correction reporting that the 2021May R5 core package had only about 25 SearchParameters and the present ones were experimental; the resolution says this was likely the same issue as FHIR-32107 in R4B.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit was found. FHIR-I minutes record the seed as a technical correction to fix in R5, and current R5 core/search package checks show the package output no longer has the reported failure.
additional_context: FHIR-32107 is the same-change-family R4B issue and was audited opportunistically. FHIR-26430/FHIR-36879 explain adjacent definition questions, and FHIR-39010 later created the separate search-parameter package for R5 and later.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current build source has active SearchParameter inputs and thousands of SearchParameter entries, and current R5/R6 package outputs do not reproduce the old missing/experimental package failure.
